posts.title: Azaadi Ka Din — Grand Launch
posts.caption:
Kuch kursiyan sirf baithne ke liye nahi hoti. Kuch kursiyan itihaas ki gawah hoti hain.

Habibs ki hairdressing legacy ek daur se shuru hui jab hunar hi pehchaan tha. Founder Habib Ahmed — ek family of elite barbers mein paida hue, London mein trained hue, aur India mein modern, professional salon culture lekar aaye. Unhone Bharat ke kai pramukh vyaktitvon ko style kiya — Indira Gandhi ji se lekar Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam tak.

Teen peedhiyon se ek hi vishwas: hairdressing sirf ek service nahi, ek craft hai. Aur aaj wahi craft aapke shehar, aapki kursi tak pahuncha hai.

Iss Independence Day, celebrate the craft that grew with India.

Desh badla. Style badla. Hunar wahi raha.

Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
Apne sabse kareeb Habibs ke liye DM karein.
posts.visualDirection: Open on a vintage barber chair in warm, low light — archival paper textures, sepia grade. Slow push-ins on scissors, hands, classic tools. Match-cut on the chair transitions sepia heritage → full-colour modern Habibs floor with present-day stylists on real clients (woman, man, a bride). Names of leaders appear as elegant text cards + voiceover only — NO recreated faces. Close on end-card: "Desh badla. Style badla. Hunar wahi raha. — Habibs."
posts.productionNotes: 25–30s. Talent: 1 senior stylist (hero) + 3–4 clients. Props: vintage chair, classic scissors/razor set, London-certificate prop, heritage set dressing. Two setups: sepia heritage corner + bright main floor. Warm, measured Hindi VO artist. GUARDRAILS: no flag on chairs/products/disposables; Kalam & Indira in VO + text only, NO look-alike casting or AI faces; "styled personalities including…" framed as fact, not endorsement. Use licensed archival stills only if rights cleared — else textures/props, no real photos.

posts.title: Teen Peedhiyan — The Habibs Legacy
posts.caption:
Ek hunar. Teen peedhiyan. Ek hi vishwas — hairdressing sirf service nahi, ek craft hai.

Swipe through the story 👉
→ Founder Habib Ahmed: born 1940, a family of elite barbers, London-trained, and the man who brought organized, professional salon culture to India.
→ Uske haath ne Bharat ke icons ko style kiya — Indira Gandhi ji & Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam jaise naam.
→ Agli peedhiyon ne is virasat ko aage badhaya — aaj Habibs 100s of salons tak pahunch chuka hai.

Aur aaj yeh legacy aapke shehar tak. Is virasat ka hissa baniye.

Desh badla. Style badla. Hunar wahi raha.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection:
8 slides, consistent cream + navy + maroon template, elegant serif headings.
1 — "The Chair That Witnessed History" (title)
2–3 — heritage textures, tools, sepia
4 — Founder Habib Ahmed (typographic portrait card — no real-leader faces)
5 — "Styled India's icons — incl. Indira Gandhi ji & Dr. Kalam" (type card)
6 — Next-gen leaders (real team photos if available)
7 — Modern salons / footprint
8 — "Desh badla. Style badla. Hunar wahi raha." + CTA
posts.productionNotes: Design task — no shoot if using brand photos + type. Assets: founder photo IF brand-owned & cleared; team photos; salon interiors; texture pack. GUARDRAILS: no recreated faces of Kalam/Indira/Nehru; do NOT claim the Nehru/Viceroy-House chapter for the founder (that's the grandfather generation, publicised by the rival JH brand) — keep to salonhabibs.in + documented obituaries.

posts.caption:
Ek achha haircut poora look badal deta hai.

Precision cuts, blow-dry, styling — for men aur women, dono. Yeh hai the Habibs finish: sharp, clean, aur bilkul aap jaisa.

Book your cut at your nearest Habibs.

posts.visualDirection: Fast, satisfying, ASMR-leaning — scissor snips, comb glides, blow-dry reveal. Bright clean salon light. Quick before→after head turns, split between one male and one female client. Trendy audio. Crisp logo end-card. Keep hygiene visible (fresh towels, sanitized tools).
posts.productionNotes: 20–25s. 2 models (1 M, 1 F). Stylists in Habibs uniform. Gear: gimbal + macro/close lens + clip mic for snip ASMR. Props: capes, clean tools tray.

posts.visualDirection: 9 slides, bold navy/cream/maroon. Slide 1 = myth-bust title. Slides 2–8 = one service each: icon + a striking service photo + one-line benefit. Slide 9 = "Poora Look. Ek Jagah." + CTA. Consistent template, big type, short on-slide copy.
posts.productionNotes: Design + stills. Need 1 clean photo per service — pull from outlet shoots or run a half-day service-photo shoot. Build an icon set. Keep on-slide captions to one line each.

posts.title: Onam Ashamsakal — Festive Ready
posts.caption:
Iss Onam, tradition ko do ek naya glow. ✨

Kasavu ki elegance, jasmine ka gajra, aur ek soft festive look — Onam ka poora look, ek hi jagah.

Onam Ashamsakal! 🌼 Get festive-ready at Habibs.

posts.visualDirection: Warm, elegant. Woman in authentic kasavu (off-white/gold); stylist finishing a low bun + real jasmine gajra; dewy makeup. Pookalam (flower rangoli) + brass nilavilakku lamp in frame, soft natural light. Graceful slow-motion, traditional-modern fusion audio. End card: Onam greeting + logo.
posts.productionNotes: 20–25s. Shoot a day ahead (post ON the 26th). 1 model, authentic kasavu + fresh jasmine. Stylist + MUA. Props: pookalam (fresh flowers), nilavilakku lamp, banana-leaf accents. CULTURAL CARE: authentic & respectful (esp. Kerala/South outlets); greeting-led, not salesy.

posts.caption:

Ek taraf: teen dukaanein, chaar bill, aur poora Saturday gone. Doosri taraf: Habibs — hair, skin, nails, brows, sab ek hi sitting mein, ek hi bill.

Do jagah kyun, jab ek kaafi hai?
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs. Book now.
posts.visualDirection: Classic split-screen. LEFT: hectic, desaturated — running between parlour/traffic/waiting, timestamps piling up, messy diegetic sound, no music. RIGHT: calm, warm — one Habibs chair, parallel services happening, single soft track, timer barely moves. Dissolve to one clean frame + line "Do jagah kyun, jab ek kaafi hai?"
posts.productionNotes: 25–30s. 1 hero model (same on both sides). Left: 2–3 quick location vibes (or implied). Right: salon floor with 2–3 services staged in parallel. Gimbal + timestamp graphics in edit. This is the flagship "engine" — reuse the setup for future comparison reels.

posts.title: Why Habibs — The Premium Standard
posts.caption:
Premium sirf ek shabd nahi. Yeh har detail mein dikhta hai.

Swipe 👉

Experience the standard. Book at your nearest Habibs.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: 6 slides, premium navy/cream + gold-maroon accents, lots of whitespace. Slide 1 = title. Slides 2–5 = one pillar each (experts / products / hygiene / consultation) with a crisp real photo + short line. Slide 6 = "Poora Look. Ek Jagah." + CTA.
posts.productionNotes: Design + real outlet photos (product shelves, sanitized tools, stylist-with-client, consultation). Use genuine brand products in frame. Keep claims truthful — only say "internationally trained" where accurate.

posts.title: Every Girl Before a Function
posts.caption:
Function kal hai. Aur abhi tak kuch bhi ready nahi. 😩

Hair a mess, kuch decide nahi hua, panic mode on… phir yaad aaya — Habibs hai na. Poora look, ek hi sitting mein sorted.

Walk in stressed, walk out glowing.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs. Book before the rush.
posts.visualDirection: Fun, fast, relatable POV humour. Messy "before" — bed, clothes everywhere, stress face → trending transition/audio → Habibs glow-up → confident exit. Text overlays carry the inner-monologue lines. Current trending audio.
posts.productionNotes: 15–20s. 1 relatable female lead with strong expressions. Home-ish setup + salon. Use a current trending audio/transition (swap at post time for whatever's trending). Keep it light & shareable.

posts.title: The Reveal — Before → After
posts.caption:
Same person. Das minute pehle. Aur ab. 🤯

Colour + cut + styling — ek complete transformation, Habibs ki chair pe. Yeh hai the difference a real craft makes.

Aapka transformation kab?
Book at Habibs. Poora Look. Ek Jagah.
posts.visualDirection: Build tension → reveal. Start on "before" (flat hair, plain). Fast process cuts — colour foils, cut, blow-dry. Big spin-reveal "after" with a hair flip and confident smile. Dramatic-then-uplifting audio, slow-mo on the reveal. Logo end-card.
posts.productionNotes: 20–25s. 1 model with strong transformation potential (a colour change reads best on camera). Senior stylist/colourist. Gear: gimbal, strong key light for the reveal, slow-mo-capable camera. Get a signed before/after release from the model.
